knowledge_abstraction.general_principle: Elementwise arithmetic on complex floating-point tensors may mishandle IEEE special values such as Inf and NaN in real or imaginary components, causing incorrect propagation of NaN or incorrect component preservation.

risk_dimensions.dtype: complex64 and complex128 floating-point complex dtypes
risk_dimensions.execution_state: Arithmetic operations on complex tensors whose real or imaginary components contain Inf or NaN

failure_mechanism.description: Complex floating-point arithmetic kernels may fail to follow IEEE 754 special-value propagation rules when infinite components are combined with finite or NaN components, leading to mathematically incorrect results.

input_exploration: Generate complex tensors with combinations of finite, positive Inf, negative Inf, and NaN in real and imaginary components
Vary complex dtype between complex64 and complex128
Cover cases where special values appear in different components across operands
Apply elementwise complex arithmetic operations such as addition and subtraction
constraint_awareness: IEEE 754 special-value propagation rules for complex arithmetic
NaN behavior for complex infinities and indeterminate forms
Backend consistency between CPU and CUDA
Reference behavior for complex special-value propagation
oracle_strategy: Compare outputs against a reference implementation such as NumPy or high-precision complex arithmetic
Detect unexpected NaN or incorrect preservation of finite and infinite components in complex results

transferability.reason: The principle applies to any API performing arithmetic on complex floating-point tensors where IEEE special-value propagation must be preserved. It is not limited to torch.add or torch.sub and can guide testing for other elementwise or reduction operations over complex dtypes.

llm_reasoning_guidance.important_considerations: Focus on special-value propagation across real and imaginary components, vary complex dtype and backend, and compare against a precise reference implementation.
generation_strategy: Generate harnesses that systematically combine finite, Inf, and NaN components across complex operands, apply multiple elementwise arithmetic operations, and validate results against a high-precision reference for IEEE special-value behavior. Generalize across APIs operating on complex dtypes rather than reproducing the original issue directly.
